events.title: Pound Rises As Robust U.K. CPI Data Fuels BoE Rate Hike
events.description: The British pound strengthened slightly against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, as the U.K. consumer price inflation rose to a one-year high in September on motor fuel prices, fueled expectations on the Bank of England (BoE) rate hike.

events.title: Pound Rises Slightly Against Majors
events.description: The British pound strengthened slightly against other major currencies in the pre-European session on Wednesday.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises On RBA Hauser Hawkish Remarks
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Wednesday, following warnings from the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser that prompted expectations of another interest rate hike.

events.title: SpaceX Shares Climb As Q3 Turns To Profit On Connectivity, SI Strength
events.description: Shares of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. or SpaceX (SPCX) were gaining around 9% in the overnight activity on the Nasdaq after Elon Musk's spaceflight company reported a significant profit in its third quarter, compared to prior year's loss, as revenues were boosted mainly by Connectivity as well as Super Intelligence or SI operations.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Wednesday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Higher With Earnings In Focus
events.description: European stocks may edge higher at open on Wednesday, with technology stocks likely to remain in focus as investors cheer robust earnings from SpaceX and Super Micro Computer.

events.title: Indian Shares Surge Led By IT Stocks
events.description: Indian shares opened on a buoyant note on Wednesday after reports suggested that a new peace proposal put forward by Qatar and Pakistan has received positive responses from Washington and Tehran, raising hopes that a breakthrough to halt the war could be announced possibly this week.

events.title: Australian Market Slips To Slight Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is slipping to slight losses in mid-market moves on Wednesday after opening in the green, extending the losses in the previous session, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 falling to near the 8,800 level, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, with a mixed performance across most sectors.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mixed on Wednesday, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, as crude oil-linked inflation concerns eased following reports of a possible peace deal between the U.S. and Iran, mediated by Pakistan and Qatar that satisfies the needs of both the warring nations. Asian markets closed mostly lower on Tuesday.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Higher At Open
events.description: Indian shares look set to open higher on Wednesday after reports suggested that a new peace proposal put forward by Qatar and Pakistan has received positive responses from Washington and Tehran, raising hopes that a breakthrough to halt the war could be announced possibly this week.

events.title: Thai Shares Due For Support On Wednesday
events.description: The Thai stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, sinking more than 20 points or 1.4 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,550-point plateau although it may stop the bleeding on Wednesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Significantly Higher
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading significantly higher on Wednesday, reversing some of the losses in the previous two sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving above the 64,700 level, with gains in exporters, financial and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in automaker stocks.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Extend Tuesday's Gains
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Tuesday ended the three-day losing streak in which it had crashed more than 950 points or 16.6 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,275-point plateau and it has a positive lead again for Wednesday's trade.
